title: X-Men in yellow and blue

images.alt: Five Marvel United X-Men in classic yellow and blue: Marvel Girl, Cyclops, Angel, Beast and a grey Iceman
Back of Marvel United Angel in yellow and blue with big white feathered wings, on an icy grey base

Marvel United Marvel Girl in yellow and blue with red hair and a blue cowl, hand to her temple, on an icy base
